caption: The video showcases a dark purple-to-magenta gradient backdrop lit by a soft, brighter glow near the top center, across which many small glowing pink particles drift steadily downward. They appear as a mix of round, out-of-focus bokeh dots and thin, near-vertical light streaks, scattered throughout the frame and trailing as they fall. Dots reaching the bottom edge leave the view while new ones emerge near the top, sustaining a continuous shower. The particles keep a loose, irregular arrangement as they fall, with the bokeh dots varying in apparent size and the streaks staying thin and near-vertical. The top-center glow stays roughly fixed while the density and brightness of surrounding particles fluctuate as they pass through it. The falling motion reads as unbroken throughout the clip.
relations: Particles near the top glow move downward, leaving the bottom edge as new ones emerge near the top.
Thin near-vertical streaks and bokeh dots fall steadily, preserving irregular spacing and varied apparent sizes.
Top-center glow stays fixed while passing particles locally alter surrounding brightness and density.
Downward drift persists continuously, with particles maintaining identity through motion and diffusion.
